notes: Listen and test every key, from the web panel: Test every key strikes the piano's 84 keys in turn while the tablet's microphone plays live in your browser, then marks any key that didn't sound; Listen plays the room live for up to 5 minutes. Listening is off until someone switches on Listening from the panel on the tablet (Piano › System); a banner shows on the tablet while the microphone is on, and nothing is recorded. System says 'A key is held on' when the piano reports a key energized with nothing playing. New tool: Install the update, so later updates can be installed from the panel without anyone at the tablet, where Android allows it.
